note: Founded as 'All Hands AI, Inc.' by Robert Brennan (CEO), Xingyao Wang (Chief AI Officer) and Graham Neubig (Chief Scientist), maintainers of the open-source OpenDevin/OpenHands agent project. Raised a $5M seed round led by Menlo Ventures (Sept 2024), per TechCrunch. The product/brand has since been renamed 'OpenHands' (site now at openhands.dev / all-hands.dev redirects to the OpenHands brand); open-source core (Apache-2.0-style project with 78,000+ GitHub stars per the company's own blog) plus a commercial 'OpenHands Cloud' SaaS and an 'Enterprise' self-host/BYOC tier. No later priced round (Series A or beyond) was found as of the check date; treat total funding and stage as based on the single confirmed seed round only — a later unannounced or unconfirmed round is possible but unverified in the time available.
